Name: Tidy Hoe Dirt
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This Content Patcher pack changes a very minor but aesthetically jarring (to me at least) aspect of tilled soil (a. k. a. HoeDirt), that it is kind of haphazard-looking, especially in narrow lines.

This is just my attempt to make it look a little more professional. Here's a visual representation of the difference:

[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/156109690059751424/1511171908031479929/Untitled.gif?ex=6a1f7c03&is=6a1e2a83&hm=b93282797e34d58f09d557650a9b8af5830acc85a9270447ee9e558091a1a287&=[/img]

The reason for finally doing something about it was my new mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47027]Closer Crops[/url], since the crops wouldn't quite fit on the very-rounded corner dirt.

Requires the one and only [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
